answer: Incident: 400 idle keys held standing for 11 epochs. Fix: decay 8% per idle epoch and deduct 15 points for each unverified claim on the record. Build the terrace from verified tasks only, and block any identity from auditing its own recruit. The karst of dormant accounts flattened in three closes, and a raven of a reviewer reopens every unverified claim. Cost to repeat: 400 keys times 11 epochs of decay plus 15 points per fake claim.
